institution: Mineral Resources and Petroleum Authority of Mongolia
review_policy: Only REVIEWED records are eligible for the public official-price selector. PARSED_UNREVIEWED, REJECTED, and AMBIGUOUS records remain outside the public bundle.

records.quality_criteria: Volatile matter Vdaf >28.0–37.0%; caking index G>65; thickness of plastic layer Y≤25mm.
records.mapping_note: This establishes a rule-based statutory raw-coal classification when the stated quality fields are evidenced. It does not establish an ETT transaction or quantity.
